item_short_desc: Rothco’s Commando Watchband is designed to provide your watch with maximum protection against the elements while reducing glare, making it perfect for outdoor enthusiasts. The watchband features a hook & loop cover that securely insulates the watch face from damage and harsh conditions. Constructed with a durable and moisture-wicking nylon composition, the watchband is comfortable to wear during any adventure and is easy to clean. Measuring 10.25 inch x 1.75 inch, it fits most standard-sized watches.
